title: COSIS Overlay: Using SI Agent Systems (SI Agents) – Single Agent

upstream_cosis_source.use_case_designation: UC-AGENT-SINGLE: COSIS Overlay: Using SI Agent Systems (SI Agents) – Single Agent

organization_tailoring.scope_note: Maps MCP 2026-07-28 engineering invariants (MCP-001..008) onto SP 800-53r5 ODPs without claiming finalized federal COSIS mandate.

primary_risks: Excessive agency and unauthorized destructive tool or API invocations
Confused-deputy credential passthrough replaying caller tokens against upstream services
Cross-request state bleed or context exhaustion from chatty CRUD tool loops
Escape from unisolated host tool-execution environments

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Bind agent tool servers to least-privilege, per-operation server credentials; prohibit client token passthrough and send zero credentials on public routes.

parameter_assignments.ac-06_odp.01: server-bound env credentials with per-route security dispatch and explicit zero-credential security: [] handling

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Verify caller Authorization headers are ignored and each route dispatches only its scoped credential.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Annotate mutating and destructive agent tools explicitly (destructiveHint=True) and quarantine destructive operations behind human/AppSec approval profiles.

parameter_assignments.ac-06.10_odp.01: DELETE, purge, credential-mutation, and privilege-modifying tool invocations

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Confirm read-only triage profiles exclude destructiveHint=True tools and release artifacts flag AppSec signoff.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Cap active tools exposed to a single agent session (<= 15 task-oriented tools), disable deprecated bidirectional callbacks (SEP-2577 sampling/roots), and block unused imports.

parameter_assignments.cm-07_odp.01: <= 15 active tools per client profile; SEP-2577 .sample()/.list_roots()/.set_logging_level() prohibited

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Assert manifest and active client profiles expose <= 15 tools and pass AST SEP-2577 deprecation checks.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Isolate agent tool execution and any code-synthesis steps inside privilege-dropped containers (--cap-drop=ALL, read-only rootfs) or OS kernel sandboxes (sandbox-exec / bwrap).

parameter_assignments.sc-39_odp.01: non-root container (--cap-drop=ALL, :ro rootfs) or OS seatbelt/bubblewrap process isolation

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Verify untrusted tool/agent processes cannot write outside designated overlays or open unauthorized sockets.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Restrict outbound HTTP calls from agent tools to pre-configured upstream base URLs via injected connection pools, blocking arbitrary URL fetching and $ref SSRF.

parameter_assignments.sc-07_odp.01: lifespan-pooled httpx.AsyncClient pinned to server base_url; remote $ref URIs forbidden

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Verify tools cannot instantiate raw HTTP clients or resolve external URI references.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Enforce upstream request timeouts (<= 15s) and dual-axis 32 KiB structured output bounding to prevent stalled or runaway tool responses from wedging the agent loop.

parameter_assignments.sc-05_odp.01: 15s upstream HTTP timeout + 32,768-byte dual-axis list/string response cap

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Simulate upstream timeout (HTTP 504/ReadTimeout) and 150 KiB list response; verify clean ToolError and bounded JSON.

tailored_controls.ai_tailoring_guidance: Provide immediate credential revocation and stateless replica termination/circuit-breaking when an autonomous agent exhibits anomalous tool-call loops.

parameter_assignments.ir-04_odp.01: per-server scoped token rotation + stateless replica circuit-breaker

tailored_controls.assessment_check: Confirm revoking a server-bound env token immediately halts upstream access with actionable ToolError.
